Cookie Policy
Updated August 16, 2026

This Cookie Policy explains how Wugweb uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our websites and use our digital services. It explains what these technologies are, why we use them, what information they may collect, and how you can manage your preferences.
01 — What are cookies?

Cookies are small files or pieces of information stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites function, remember preferences, understand how visitors use them and, where enabled, support analytics or other services.
Wugweb may also use other tracking technologies that perform similar functions, including:

items: Local storage (storing preference configurations on your browser)
Pixels & web beacons (small image files triggering server scripts)
Tags, scripts, and software development kits (SDKs)

cookie-policy.x: This policy covers all such technologies where applicable.
02 — How we use cookies
We use cookies and similar technologies across the following categories:

items: Strictly Necessary: Essential for the website to function, secure session authentication, manage cookie preferences, and process subscription checkouts (via payment gateways). These cannot be disabled.
Functional: Used to remember your dashboard choices, preferences, and workspace settings.
Analytics: Used to monitor traffic, load times, page performance, and general error monitoring to help improve Wugweb.

cookie-policy.x: 03 — What information may be collected?
Depending on your choices and consent settings, cookies may record the following details:

items: Your IP address, approximate geographical region, and browser information.
Device types, operating systems, and page navigation duration/paths.
Referral sources and interaction counts (clicks, active inputs).
